name: Floww Lock
description:
A customizable, macOS-style liquid-glass lock screen: your own clock, wallpaper, fonts, glass and layout. With Floww Music installed and enabled, its player and lyrics are built in.

The unlock-dialog session mode is required because this extension only changes the lock screen. It restyles and re-lays out GNOME's unlock dialog, never replaces the password prompt and never takes keyboard focus, and puts everything back when the screen unlocks or the extension is disabled.
